Breece Hall.note: Questionable (knee) for Week 3 vs. Lions; limited in practice Wednesday and Friday after being upgraded from a Wednesday DNP, a real doubt on a starting RB. Sources: newyorkjets.com official Friday injury report, draftsharks.com Week 3 report.

Tony Pollard.note: Questionable (ankle) for Week 3 vs. Giants; missed Wednesday practice and returned Thursday only as a limited participant with ankle soreness, not fully cleared. Sources: Yahoo Sports ("Titans injury report: Tony Pollard, Tyjae Spears sit out"), Yahoo Sports follow-up ("Tony Pollard returns... limited").

Rashod Bateman.note: Questionable (ankle) for Week 3 vs. Cowboys; limited Thursday, did not practice at all Friday. Ravens' WR corps is already down Zay Flowers, so this is a real doubt. Sources: baltimoreravens.com official injury report, Yardbarker ("Ravens Receive Brutal Injury News Before Cowboys Game").

Brock Bowers.note: Questionable (knee, post-meniscus procedure) for Week 3 vs. Saints; limited Wednesday/Thursday, did not practice Friday, described as a genuine game-time decision. Sources: raiders.com ("1 Raider ruled out, 3 questionable"), SI.com/ClutchPoints ("Bowers Questionable... game-time decision").

Nico Collins.note: Ruled out for Week 3 vs. Colts with a hamstring injury, will miss his second straight game. Sources: cw39.com ("Texans rule out Nico Collins, Jadeveon Clowney for Sunday vs. Colts"), si.com/nfl/texans ("Texans-Colts Week 3 Injury Report: Houston Rules Out 5 Players, 2 Starters").

Rico Dowdle.note: Ruled out for Week 3 vs. Bengals with a toe injury. Sources: steelers.com ("Week 3 Injury Report (Bengals)"), si.com/nfl/steelers ("Pittsburgh Steelers Week 3 Injury Report vs. Bengals").

Mack Hollins.note: Placed on injured reserve (abdomen) ahead of Week 3 vs. Jaguars; out at least four games. Sources: espn.com ("WR Mack Hollins (abdomen) placed on injured reserve"), patriots.com ("Injury Report Analysis: ... two players ruled out, two players listed as questionable ... for Patriots vs. Jaguars in Week 3").

Michael Pittman.note: Questionable (foot) for Week 3 vs. Bengals; missed Week 2 with the same injury and was limited in practice all week, status still cloudy for Sunday. Sources: steelersdepot.com ("Steelers' Week 3 Friday Injury Report: Two Players Ruled Out, Four Others Questionable"), rotoballer.com ("Michael Pittman Jr. Enters Week 3 Matchup With Bengals With a Questionable Tag").

DJ Moore.note: Questionable (shoulder, AC joint sprain) for Week 3 vs. Chargers; limited Wed/Fri, missed Thursday's practice, HC Joe Brady called him a game-time decision. Sources: si.com/nfl/bills ("Bills' Final Week 3 Injury Report: Game Status for DJ Moore, Ed Oliver, Keon Coleman"), nfl.com Week 3 injury report (Bills QUESTIONABLE: WR DJ Moore).

Adonai Mitchell.note: Questionable (finger) for Week 3 vs. Lions; limited in practice with a heavy wrap/splint after his finger got caught in a teammate's jersey, ESPN's Rich Cimini reports "some concern" over the injury. Sources: nbcsports.com ("Adonai Mitchell (finger) questionable after 2 LPs"), espn.com ("Jets elevate Sterling Shepard with Adonai Mitchell in question").

Jaylen Warren.note: Questionable (shoulder) for Week 3 vs. Bengals, limited in practice all week; Steelers already have Rico Dowdle ruled out, leaving the backfield thin. Sources: cbssports.com ("Steelers' Jaylen Warren: Idle for first Week 3 practice"), nfl.com Week 3 injury report (Steelers QUESTIONABLE: RB Jaylen Warren).

Mike Evans.note: Questionable (hip) for Week 3 vs. Cardinals; missed Wednesday and Thursday practice after banging up his hip in Week 2 vs. Miami, returned as a limited participant Friday. ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports he is expected to play, but the official tag is still Questionable, not cleared. Sources: 49ers.com official injury report ("Nick Bosa OUT vs. Cardinals; Mike Evans Questionable Ahead of #AZvsSF"), CBS Sports ("49ers' Mike Evans: Questionable for Week 3").
